Mei-Yu Wang (王 美雨ワン・メイユイ, Wang Mei-Yui), nicknamed Mii-chan, is one of the students of Class 1-D.


Appearance

Mei-Yu Wang Anime Appearance
Mei-Yu Wang's full appearance.
Mei has indigo hair tied up in twin-tails and pink violet eyes. She is normally seen wearing the female school uniform.

Personality she’s a sweet and airheaded girl

Yōsuke Hirata

In volume 9, she revealed to Ayanokoji that she liked Hirata ever since the entrance ceremony, but Mii-chan thinks she isn't good enough for Hirata. Additionally, she revealed that she had never fallen in love before and couldn’t muster the courage to confess.

In volume 10, she was the only one who continuously reached out to him during his period of self-isolation and depression, however, she was constantly rejected and hurdled with abuse by him. On one occasion, Hirata almost physically lashed out at her before he was stopped. Some in the class called it compassion before realizing that it was out of love. Hirata doesn’t reciprocate her feelings as he felt like he wasn't yet ready for romance and would probably never be. In spite of that, he still acknowledges her feelings and was grateful that she never gave up on him unlike their classmates when he was being difficult. Her feelings for him are still as strong as ever and can’t be considered simply as a crush as she did not hold anything negative against him.

Kiyotaka Ayanokōji

LN Vol 09-06
Ayanokoji asking Mii-chan when did she liked Hirata.
In volume 9 Mii-chan approached Ayanokōji and invited him to a cafe and asked him for advice in regards to Hirata. Mii-chan told Ayanokōji that Hirata told her that Ayanokōji is the most reliable and level-headed person in their class. Mii-chan asked Ayanokōji if Hirata was dating anyone after Hirata broke up with Karuizawa. Mii-chan then told Ayanokōji that she liked Hirata but she doesn't have any confidence because she has many rivals and that she hadn't fallen in love before. Ayanokōji told her not to be impatient since Hirata is a good person and after Hirata broke up with Karuizawa, it was unlikely that he will accept any confessions towards him quickly. Mii-chan told him her impression of Ayanokōji. She thought that since Ayanokōji is a silent person, many people had the impression that Ayanokōji is a scary person but her impression of Ayanokōji differs. She now thought of him as someone who is approachable and patient when listening to other people's thoughts.

JAPANESE

entries.name: Advanced Nurturing High School
entries.content:
Advanced Nurturing High School (高こう度ど育いく成せい高こう等とう学校がっこう, Kōdo Ikusei Kōtō Gakkō), also known as Tokyo Metropolitan Advanced Nurturing High School (東とう京きょう都と高こう度ど育いく成せい高こう等とう学校がっこう, Tōkyōto Kōdo Ikusei Kōtō Gakkō) in the anime, is a school established by the Japanese government to nurture young graduates that will support the country. It boasts a 100% employment and college entry rate, and with thorough, state-directed teaching methods, it spares no effort in pursuing the nation’s desired future. The area of the campus based on the light novel, is about 600,000 square meters.[1]

Map


School Landscape
Rules

Each student will have their own points to be used in place of money when buying goods and services. There is nothing, within the realm of reason, that cannot be bought on campus using points.[2][3]
Each class is assigned class points. Class points will fluctuate based on the affiliated students’ behavior and the results of certain tests. Every month, each student is assigned private points equal to their class points times 100.[4]
Any student who fails to meet the required score on a midterm or final exam will be expelled. The threshold for expulsion is 50% of the average score of the rest of the class in any given subject.[5]
Class A through D labels are provisional and can change based on class point assignments. The class with the current highest total class points will be named Class A, with B, C, and D, being named respectively in descending order.[6][7]
Students are allowed to exchange private points among themselves. The acquisition of another students’ private points through fraud or threat will result in severe punishment, but the trading of points under any contract deemed legitimate will be left up to personal discretion.[8]
Students can buy the right to transfer to the class of their choosing. 20,000,000 private points are required to do this.[9]
All students must stay in on-campus housing and are forbidden to leave the campus except for certain special occasions. Additionally, contact with all outsiders is forbidden, including family and guardians.[10]
ADVERTISEMENT

Uniforms

Tokyo Metropolitan Advanced Nurturing High School Logo
School Logo
The uniform for male students usually consists of a white dress shirt beneath a red button-up blazer, paired with dull green pants, brown shoes, and a blue or burgundy tie.

Female students wear a similar uniform, consisting of a white dress shirt and a red button-up blazer, along with a white miniskirt, black socks that vary from calf-length to thigh-length, brown shoes, and a blue or burgundy bow-tie.

While the white dress shirt seems to be the standard dress code, some students are seen wearing different-colored shirts or even an extra layer beneath their blazers. For example, Kei Karuizawa wears a light blue shirt while Mio Ibuki and Haruka Hasebe each wear an additional orange shirt under their respective blazers.

Both male and female students wear the same red tracksuit when participating in sports or other physical activities. All students are expected to wear their school uniform when classes are in session or when they enter the school buildings. [11]
ADVERTISEMENT

Facilities

Dormitories

BD1 Location 10
Exterior View
The main characters, Kiyotaka Ayanokōji (who resides at Room 401), Suzune Horikita, and Kikyō Kushida, reside in one of the four building units that are used for dormitory purposes. Each of the units is a 15-storey building comprised of not less than 140 rooms that are individually divided among students. [12][13] The first seven floors above the ground floor are dedicated to male students while the upper seven floors are for the female students. [14] Boys are technically not allowed to enter the area where the girls live after 8pm. [15] These buildings are arrayed by a pair of elevators, and possibly a section where the fire exit is positioned. [16]

Additionally, each room in each building is designed to be as minimal as possible and is enough for a student's survival. [17][18] According to Kiyotaka's estimate, the room is about 8 tatami mats big, thus, 13.2496 m2 in area. [19] It is known to have its distinctive security passcode which is accessible through duplicate green cards. [20] It is also known to be equipped with an internal telephone line system that is available all the time for all those that are residing in this area. [21]

The dormitory is known to be near to public spheres such as the park and boulevard. [22] Details about the head manor and dorm staff are yet to be revealed in the series.

School Complex

Classrooms

Opening-02
Standard Classroom Design
Every classroom is equipped with a whiteboard, TV-screens, lockers, and fixed 25 student tables, whereas, in the light novels, it can vary based on the number of students in-field. Surveillance cameras are also present in this area. [23]

Cafeteria

The main function of this area is to provide a standard meal to students with the exchange of private points. The meals are priced with great diversity which is directly proportional to the taste they offer. This area is also known to be under the surveillance of cameras. [24]

Student Council Room

This room is made for activities related to the Student Council's duties such as for holding a regular special meeting with leaders of successful classes for each year level and for management of local student affairs. This room has a big U-shaped table with comfy seats.It is also known to be equipped with a projector and automatic window blinders. This area is revealed to be somewhere near the school's swimming pool. [25]

Swimming Pool

BD1 Location 3
This area is one of the non-surveilled places inside the campus. It has three main sections: the main swimming pool area, the audience's seats located on the second floor, and the changing rooms. The main swimming pool area follows the race course suggested and prescribed by the Olympic Games, which is having 50 metres (164.0 ft) in length.

Library

School Library
School Library
This is an airconditioned area that is specially made for book archiving and referencing. Other kinds of student activities such as group study and meeting are also allowed in the area. [26]

Details about the librarian and the library staff are yet to be revealed in the series.

It is also noted that the architectural structure of this building is somehow patterned to Akita International University's Nakajima Memorial Library.

Gymnasium

This multi-purpose area is where the annual opening ceremonies and club fair are being conducted. It is also used by the Basketball Club for their regular evening training. [27]

Keyaki Mall

This area is a 5-story main mall complex of Advanced Nurturing High School.

Pallet

In the anime, this area is inside the Keyaki Mall.[28] However, in the light novel, this area is located on the first floor of the school building. It is a well-known cafe among the female where they not only can buy drinks and beverages but also study and meet up for secular reasons. [29]

SIVCAMERA

SIVCAMERA Front
SIVCAMERA front view
This area is inside the Keyaki Mall, the main mall complex of Advanced Nurturing High School. It is an electronic store that offers various kind of services; one of which is for electronic device warranty repair. This is where Airi Sakura, with the presence of Kiyotaka Ayanokōji and Kikyō Kushida, brought her camera in order for it to be fixed. [30]

So far, the only known employee of this store is Yukitsu Kusuda, who is now in custody of the police due to his attempted assault against Airi Sakura. [31]

Karaoke Clubs

This area is inside the Keyaki Mall, the main mall complex of Advanced Nurturing High School. Aside from offering rooms for disco and karaoke, alcohol and exquisite beverages are also being served here. This location is often visited by Class 1-C students and some 1-D students. [32]

Public Spheres

Within the confines of Advanced Nurturing High School, most of the areas in the public sphere are under the surveillance of cameras. There's also an active group of police that regularly patrols the area. [33][34]

Park

This circular area is comprised of several benches on its perimeter with each of them facing the fountain at its center. [35]

Boulevard

It is a non-surveillance area composed of a pathway made of bricks, a considerable number of street lights, and an iron fence that separates the landform to the sea. [36]

Convenience Store

Leisure Pool

ADVERTISEMENT

Plot

Only the graduating students of Class A will receive the university and employment recommendation by the school. It is later revealed that every middle school student in Japan is evaluated by the government whether they are allowed to enroll or not. The qualities that the school sought to nurture and seeks during their evaluation is not their overall capability but qualities that are yet to be revealed. Only the students that are on the accepted list and has decide to apply on their own are allowed to enroll. Kiyotaka Ayanokōji is the only student that was allowed to enroll without being evaluated.[37]

Kinoshita first appears in Light Novel Volume 5 where during the girls' Obstacle Course Race, shortly before reaching the finishing line, She seemingly collided with Horikita and isn't able to finish the race due to leg injury. Mio Ibuki (伊い吹ぶき 澪みお, Ibuki Mio) is a student of Class 1-C. Not only does she possess excellent academic qualities, but her physical ability is also not to be underestimated. She is skilled in combat, having the knowledge of several martial skills that can rival those of many martial artists.















ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Mio Ibuki Anime Appearance
Mio Ibuki's full appearance in the anime.
Mio is a teenage girl of average height who has short blue hair. Her hair has a single strand of hair sticking up, and she has purple eyes.

She is usually seen wearing the school uniform with a blue bowtie and orange shirt. Like all the other first years, she wore the red tracksuit during the special island exam period.
Personality

Mio prefers acting alone to socializing, which is one of the reasons why she is often isolated inside of her class.[1]

Unlike her peers, she doesn't seem to enjoy the violence inflicted on others, as shown when she flinched after Kakeru Ryūen smashed a glass bottle on the head of Daichi Ishizaki, or when Albert Yamada was ordered to beat Daichi and the others for their failure in attempting to get Ken Sudō expelled.[2] She made it clear that she disapproved of their cruelty and wanted them to stop their actions.

She doesn't enjoy being insulted, as demonstrated when she told off Kakeru for treating her like a plaything when he made advances on her. She appears to not like being pitied, as shown when she angrily slapped away the hand of Kiyotaka Ayanokōji when he was trying to help her up after she was knocked to the ground.[3]

Because of her time with Kakeru, she expects mistrust and deception, or even accusations towards herself. She told off Kiyotaka and his group to leave her alone when they enquired about her.[4] However, she can be surprised, such as when people actually give her the benefit of the doubt, for example, she was caught off-guard when Kiyotaka stated he trusted her after some panties were stolen from the girl's tent during the island exam.[5] She was so shocked at his belief in her she nervously blushed while thanking him for it. She is also somewhat curious, as she showed interest when Kikyō Kushida and Haruki Yamauchi commented on how incredibly close Suzune Horikita and Kiyotaka were lately.

Episode 011-06
Mio's true self.
She is very deceptive, as it is revealed that she infiltrated D-Class to steal Suzune's keycard, despite the class showing her kindness by taking her in and providing food and other necessities. She showed no remorse in stealing the card, even defeating Suzune in a fight.[6]
ADVERTISEMENT

Plot

Mio Ibuki made her debut sitting at the karaoke bar of Keyaki Mall where she is seen flinching after Kakeru Ryūen's smashes a glass bottle over Daichi Ishizaki's head.[7]

She is later seen with Kakeru and his henchmen after failing to get Ken Sudō of class D expelled. She looks away as Albert Yamada proceeded to beat up Daichi again for failing in his attempt to expel Ken [2].

Episode 008-21
Kiyotaka attempting to help Mio up.
During the school cruise, Mio confronted Kakeru where she demanded him to stop his actions, but he disregarded her words and told her to come back to his room while putting his arm around her. Disgusted, she slapped away his hand and demanded him to take her seriously, but she was ignored as he walked away. When she tried to stop him, Albert intervened, and she called him a puppet for following his every order. She tried once more to speak to Kakeru, but Albert got in the way and pushed her against the rails, commanding her to stop. Kiyotaka Ayanokōji came to help her up, but she angrily slapped his hand away and chastised him to not get involved in her business and stormed off.[8]

During the survival test, Kiyotaka, Airi Sakura and Haruki Yamauchi found Mio injured. She had bruises on her face and was slumped against a tree. Mio was then taken back to class D's camp by the group, despite her protests that they were enemies.[9]

Episode 011-07
Mio talking to Kiyotaka asking if he doesn't trust her like the others.
The morning after the underwear theft incident, Mio approached Kiyotaka as he was working on pitching up the guys' tent.[10] She stated that she finds the theft unforgivable and tells him that she is aware that people like Ken would believe she was the one behind it because she was an outsider. Mio stated she knew Kiyotaka holds the same belief, but he reveals that he trusts her, catching her by surprise. She thanked him and blushed nervously. Since then, she became more curious about Kiyotaka's relationships with other people, turning around and stealing glances when Kikyō Kushida and Haruki Yamauchi both commented on how incredibly close Suzune Horikita and Kiyotaka were lately. While doing so, she caught a glimpse of the leader card in Suzune's possession. Since her camera had been mysteriously destroyed, she managed to steal it while Suzune was taking a bath by herself in the waterfall, after Haruki poured mud on her.[11]

Shortly afterwards, somebody started a fire at camp, burning the survival test manual, which led to even more trust problems within D Class. Mio used this as an opportunity to sneak away from the camp.[11]

Episode 011-14
Mio and Suzune fighting.
Suspecting that the incident was Mio's doing, Suzune searched for her and discovered that she did in fact steal the key card. Mio attacked Suzune, despite the rules prohibiting violence against students from other classes, knowing that as long as nobody noticed, she could get away with it. Taking advantage of Suzune's fever, Mio defeated her and brought the leader card to a student who requested evidence.[11]

It was later revealed that Kiyotaka had deduced that Mio was a spy sent from class 1-C. Kiyotaka was also the one who discovered Mio's hidden camera and two-way radio. Having seen Kakeru possessing the other radio at the beach, he deduced Kakeru had not left the island and was lying in wait until the test was over. Kakeru had planned to deceive everyone into believing he, along with the majority of his class, retired, in order to gain the most points for his class in the test. Kiyotaka then began to stage events so that Mio could find out who the D-Class' leader was, such as bribing Haruki to splash mud on Horikita, so Mio could fulfill her mission and leave them. Kiyotaka had planned to change leaders for class 1-D after classes 1-A and 1-C verified that Suzune's name was on the card. Kiyotaka then executed his final plan, after Suzune's health deteriorated to the point that it became a valid enough reason to change leaders for their class. After the island test was complete, C-Class came last, and Mio apologized to Kakeru about incorrectly guessing class 1-D's leader (although she was right, but Kiyotaka had changed leaders without her knowledge). He forgave her, recognizing that someone outwitted them, leading to their loss and class 1-D's victory.[6]

Mio is shown to be a capable fighter, but she is not as strong as Kakeru Ryūen, who is able to dodge her attacks and overpower her easily. In the special island exam arc, she defeated Suzune Horikita in combat. After the events of the exam, Kiyotaka states that Mio likely would have won even if Suzune wasn't sick. Miyabi Nagumo (南な雲ぐも 雅みやび, Nagumo Miyabi) is a student of Class 3-A at Advanced Nurturing High School. He served as the Student Council President, succeeding Manabu Horikita.












Appearance

Miyabi Nagumo Anime Appearance.png
full appearance in the anime.
Nagumo is a tall, fair-skinned teenager with light blond hair and light blue eyes. Kei Karuizawa says that he doesn’t lack in the looks department but to her he is not someone who can rival the likes of Kiyotaka Ayanokōji.
Personality

Nagumo is a leader who likes to rule through an iron-fist, and is kind of a man who would expel anyone who tries to oppose him. Manabu Horikita suspects him for expelling 7 out of 12 students from the second year that had Nagumo involved in one way or another. He considers Manabu as his rival and keeps on challenging him, also trying to prove that he is better than Manabu. Despite Manabu already graduating, he now targets his little sister and takes joy in the fact that she is somewhat now directly under his control after she joined the student council.

It is later revealed by Ikuto Kiriyama that Nagumo promised the second year students reforms where ones who surpasses the boundaries between classes and are capable of making allies from different classes will be pulled up to A-Class. He believes in the ideology of winning the war at the expense of a battle as he lost to Manabu but was also able to drive Akane Tachibana to the point of expulsion.

He is shown to be quite persuasive as he got Honami Ichinose to give up her secret to him without much interaction between them beforehand. Although, this is also due to her gullible and credulous nature. He is also extremely narcissistic, but not to the point of Rokusuke Kōenji. He also likes to make those around him into his "toys", showing his deprave mindset. He is also not afraid to hurt his "toys" or sacrifice them for himself and his benefits such as when he gave Ichinose's secret to Arisu Sakayanagi. He can be livid when things doesn’t go his way such as when Kiyotaka Ayanokōji intervened during his plan to force Honami to become his girlfriend, only to have her saved by Kiyotaka instead.

He is also seen to be attracted to hot girls such as Honami Ichinose and Suzune Horikita and tries to charm them whenever he has the chance. He purposely refers to them by their first name after brief interactions and will take whatever chances to get close to them. For instance, he attempted to force Honami to rely only on him by entering a relationship with him as well as prolonging a hand shake with Suzune and looking at her tantalisingly. He has a reputation and aura of being a womaniser amongst the student body but despite that, some still views him in a good light.

Nagumo also has a tendency to be overconfident at times as shown in the Uninhabited Island Exam where he approached Kiyotaka Ayanokōji without any of his backup Free Groups in I2. Despite this, he is also shown to be calm and calculative as shown in the Mixed Training Camp where he conducted his plan without displaying arrogance nor confidence unlike his latter confrontation with Kiyotaka.
Background

Nagumo was originally a Class B student when he first entered the school.
Plot

In Volume 8, Nagumo made a bet with Manabu Horikita. He eventually lost their bet but successfully drove Akane Tachibana to expulsion (which was later negated) with the assistance of Momoko Ikari.[1]

In Volume 10, Nagumo tried to make a deal with Honami Ichinose to provide her with 4,043,019 private points. In exchange, Ichinose would have to date Nagumo. It was originally done to make sure Ichinose had enough points (20,000,000) so that she would not have to sacrifice a person to be expelled in The Class Poll special exam. However, this was thwarted by Kiyotaka Ayanokoji who came up with a substitute dealer in place of Nagumo.[2]

In Volume 1 of Second Year Arc, as said by Takuya Yagami, Nagumo was present in the creation of the bounty made by Acting Director Tsukishiro on providing 20,000,000 private points to the 1st year student who would be able to expel Kiyotaka Ayanokoji before the second semester.[3]

In Volume 2 of Seocnd Year Arc, Nagumo tried to make Fūka Kiryūin his ally but the latter rejected it.[4]

In Volume 3 of Second Year Arc, Nagumo took part in the Uninhabited Island Exam by employing the 'Free Group' strategy. He did this by commanding lower ranked 3rd year groups to monopolize the amount of points he and the other large groups of that year would get.[5]

In Volume 4 of Second Year Arc, Nagumo's large group consisting of him and students from his class including Nazuna Asahina placed an overall ranking of 2nd place in the Uninhabited Island Exam with a total of 325 points, 2 points behind 1st place Rokusuke Kōenji's small group and 64 points above 3rd place Arisu Sakayanagi's large group. The main reason for him not getting 1st place was Kiyotaka Ayanokoji who injured him in I2 which cost Nagumo to lose time. Afterwards, Nagumo ordered the 3rd year students to follow and keep tabs on Kiyotaka.[6]

In 2nd year volume 4.5, Miyabi wanted to get a revenge against Kiyotaka, when he saw Kiyotaka talking with Honami, Miyabi told Honami that Kiyotaka and Kei have been dating which Kiyotaka confirmed and this made Honami sad.

In 2nd year volume 6, He called Kiyotaka to talk with him and brought Honami to make Honami feel pain.

In 2nd year volume 7, Kiyotaka said he is going to need his help and wanted to help him. Miyabi said why should he help him, which Kiyotaka said if he helps him he might have a challenge with him but if Miyabi refuses Kiyotaka won't fight him anymore no matter who Miyabi do something. Miyabi threaten Kiyotaka that he will go after Kei, but Kiyotaka said it won't make any difference who he goes, Kiyotaka said it is true that he is strong but he can't protect anyone 24/7. Miyabi helped Kiyotaka in a way that Takuya got expelled.

In 2nd year volume 9, Miyabi got retired from being Student council president, Miyabi said he wants to have a challenge with Kiyotaka who will be student council president. There were two people who could take his place, Honami and Suzune. But Honami did not wanted to continue working in there and quit, so Suzune become president. Miyabi asked her to bring two students for Student council, A second year to take Honami's place and a first year to take Takuya's place. Miyabi said to Kiyotaka their challenge still remains.

Nazuna Asahina (朝あさ比ひ奈な なずな, Asahina Nazuna) is a student of Class 3-A at the Advanced Nurturing High School.



Appearance


Nazuna Asahina Anime Appearance
Nazuna Asahina's full appearance.
Nazuna is a teenage girl who could be seen as rough-looking [1] (according to Kiyotaka Ayanokōji) with waist-length chocolate-brown hair that is adorned by a hair pin in the shape of a sunflower on the right side, along with two ordinary hair clips on the same side and purple eyes.

She was seen sporting a school tracksuit with gym trousers; her uniform was zipped up to half to allow her chest breathing space.
ADVERTISEMENT

Personality

Nazuna has rough mannerisms, but she is very well liked and influential within the 2nd years who is laid-back and playful, but she is also dutiful and never forgets to repay a debt made to her. She has a habit of judging people too quickly as seen with Kiyotaka Ayanokōji when she assumed him to be a pitiable flirt, when really he was a good person who retrieved her most precious belonging.[2] She is ashamed and embarrassed with herself for thinking that.

She possesses an amulet to which she cares for very much. She believes it to be an object of good luck, and it give her great mental strength when she has it on her. She claims it be a harbinger of destiny that not only watches over romance, but brings people together in a fated encounter.[2]

She is close to Miyabi Nagumo, but unlike her fellow second years, she does not idolize him despite being in the same class.[1]
ADVERTISEMENT
Plot

Nazuna's first appearance is in Volume 7. During her way back to the dorm, she was walking in front of Kiyotaka Ayanokōji when, after the call with Miyabi Nagumo, the current Student Council President, she slipped because of the icy ground, dropping her amulet. Kiyotaka picked it up and brought it to her dorm's security guard.

Later, during the Mixed Training Camp in Volume 8, she learned that Kiyotaka was the one who brought her precious amulet back. She felt a bit guilty that her words cause Kiyotaka to try confronting Miyabi. In her view, there is no chance of winning, so she provided information of Miyabi as compensation.
Abilities

Trivia

According to the amulet event, Nazuna somehow hopes for Miyabi Nagumo's defeat, even though they are in the same class and have known each other for a long time. She spoke to herself after hanging up that Manabu Horikita, the previous president, disappointed her that he could not stop Miyabi from his reign.
For the 2nd Year arc, when asked about her aspirations for the next year, Nazuna answered To stop the student council president's rampage... I suppose? I don't know what he's going to do If I let him roam free, right

Atsuomi Ayanokōji (綾あやの小こう路じ 篤あつ臣おみ), also known as Professor Ayanokōji, is the father of the protagonist, Kiyotaka Ayanokōji. He is the founder and currently in control of the White Room.

Appearance

Atsuomi Ayanokōji Anime Appearance.png
Atsuomi Ayanokōji's full appearance in the anime.
Professor Ayanokōji is a middle aged man who looks to be in his 40s. Like his son, he has brown hair and has a more sterner look.

Personality

According to Chairman Sakayanagi, he has stronger ambitions than anyone and an unyielding and indomitable fighting spirit, despite having never possessed any special talent. That is the reason for his rise, to the extent that, at one point in time, he could move the country.[1]

Despite being proud of his son, Professor Ayanokōji only seems to value him more as a possession. He openly stated that he knew his son would not be fooled by a tactic showing signs of any fatherly affection. He also tried to command Kiyotaka to sign the withdrawal form.
ADVERTISEMENT

Background

Professor Ayanokōji was said to be a commoner, who has never graduated from a top university or even possessed an outstanding athleticism. His former lover is also the same, and none of their relatives show any signs of remarkable abilities and talents.

Around 20 years ago, he established the White Room, an educational institution to raise a human and removing unnecessary things from their education, with the ultimate goal of creating generations of perfect individuals to lead Japan in the future.[1]

As told in Volume 7, there seems to be very minimal to no interaction between him and his son, Kiyotaka. Kiyotaka himself was seen as the most successful product of the White Room. However, when the institution was shut down for one year, he managed to escape, with the help of their butler, Matsuo.

Kiyotaka then went to the Advanced Nurturing High School. The school's chairman, Mr Sakayanagi, was an acquaintance of Professor Ayanokōji and holds him in high regards. While Kiyotaka wasn't on the school's admission list, Chairman Sakayanagi made an exception and approved him based on his own judgement. [2]
ADVERTISEMENT
Plot

He first appeared in Volume 7, when he came to Advanced Nurturing High School to call Kiyotaka back to the White Room. When Kiyotaka refused to return, he went saying that he will still bring him back to the White Room at any cost. [2]
Trivia

The silhouette of Professor Ayanokōji can be seen in the ending of the 11th episode in the eyes of Kiyotaka.
He appears in the opening intro, with his full face shown before his introduction

Riku Utomiya (宇う都と宮みや 陸りく, Utomiya Riku) is a character from the 2nd Year Arc of the You-Zitsu series. He is a student of Class 1-C in Advanced Nurturing High School.













ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Riku has straight dark blue hair and green eyes. He wears the standard male school uniform.
Personality

Riku seems to have a calm personality, usually speaking casually to other people and his class seems to trust him in talking with the people in other classes. He does dislike people like Kazuomi Housen who use violence to get what they want and has no problem picking a fight with him if he goes too far.
Plot

Riku is first introduced in Second Year Volume 1 walking up to Kiyotaka Ayanokoji with Sakurako Tsubaki asking Kiyotaka if he would partner up with Tsubaki because she had a C- in her OAA and was in risk not finding a partner up until now. Kiyotaka ended up refusing their offer saying that he already had a potential partner in mind. Tsubaki and Riku accepted that and left after Riku gave his phone number to Kiyotaka if anything happened.


Riku clashing with Hōsen
He represented Class 1-C in a meeting between students of the four first-year classes, in order to negotiate regarding group formation for the upcoming uninhabited island test. He clashed with Hōsen during their meeting and accused him of being the cause of Class 1-C student Hatano's expulsion.

He is in the same group as Hiroya Tokitō and Hosen during the school trip in 2nd Year Volume 11, and is quick to notice when Tokito and Hosen disappear. He finds Tokito being beaten by Ryuen while Hosen is also about to get involved. He steps in to help his senior against Ryuen, whilst simultaneously berating Hosen. Before things can escalate further, all parties scatter when other students start to gather to see what the commotion is about.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities

Riku is shown to have high physical abilities as his OAA is rated an A for Physical Ability. When he grabbed Hōsen's wrist to stop him from lashing out at the others, Hōsen immediately knew that Riku was fairly strong.

Rokusuke Kōenji (高円こうえん寺じ 六助ろくすけ, Kōenji Rokusuke) is one of the students of Class 1-D who comes from a well-known family of scholars. However, he ended up in Class-D for his egotistical behavior.










Appearance

Rokusuke Kōenji LN 2nd Year Arc visual.png
Rokusuke's full appearance in the light novel.
Rokusuke Kōenji Anime Appearance.png
Rokusuke's full appearance in the anime.
Rokusuke is a tall and well-built young man with straight shoulder-length blonde hair and maroon-gradient eyes.

He is often seen wearing the standard school uniform.

Personality

Rokusuke comes across as arrogant, self-entitled, and overconfident, no doubt due to his family's wealthy status and pedigree. When he was first introduced, he speaks to Kikyō Kushida with a contemptuous and sarcastic gentleman-like way of speaking while refusing to move from his position even though there was an elderly lady in need of a seat.

Rokusuke's egotistical and pompous nature and his inability to work with others can be a foil as it is what landed him in D-Class in the first place but he appears to not pay it any mind. He looks down on his classmates as shown when he taunted Ken Sudō about his imminent possible expulsion after his fight with C-Class. His self-inflated view of himself was further shown when on the cruise, he repeatedly complimented his looks in a mirror and when he refused to dry himself since it was menial work unworthy of him, causing onlookers to scorn at his blatant narcissism.

Unsurprisingly, Rokusuke has a self-serving and vainglorious nature as he later abandoned his class during the survival test so that he would not have to participate in it which caused the class to lose points. He showed no remorse in and after the act, revealing how selfish he can truly be at times. In some aspects, he is quite similar if not worse than Kiyotaka, where he doesn’t like to be disturbed and treasure his own personal time. He also couldn’t care less of what others thinks of him nor does he care what happens to them as long as nothing happens to him.

Unlike the other students in his class, he does not worry himself about earning points as his family can simply buy them for him.

Rokusuke's personality and abilities allows him to be completely unaffected by any sort of attack or threat as he just laughs it off or turns the tables around on his attackers.

Rokusuke has a habit of nicknaming others like:

Kikyō Kushida - Pretty Girl
Kiyotaka Ayanokōji - Elevator Boy
Ken Sudō - Red Hair
Arisu Sakayanagi - Little Girl
Kakeru Ryūen - Dragon Boy and Mr. Naughty
  Spoiler warning: Plot from light novel beyond official English releases details follow. Click here to show spoilers.

Plot

In Episode 1, he is first introduced on the bus, where he speaks to Kikyō Kushida. Here he refuses to move from his position even though there was an elderly lady in need of a seat. Eventually another person volunteers their seat.

Rokusuke volunteered to join Yōsuke Hirata's plan to explore. He passed through the forest by doing an acrobatic-movement along the trees, outpacing Kiyotaka Ayanokōji and Airi Sakura enough to vanish from sight range. He then dropped out of the camp by swimming and escaping to a nearby ship, causing a loss of 30 S-points to D-Class. At night, he complimented the beauty of the moon, while on the island his classmates were upset.[2]

After the class returns from the island, Rokusuke compliments them on coming back victorious once they uncovered all the class leaders. Ken confronts him on ditching them, as he laughs this and defends his act by stating he was ill and needed to recover, while the class were not convinced.[3]

Rokusuke is adept in his academics as he was able to score a passing grade on the mid-term. He was one of the few people who didn't take and memorize the old test answers from Kikyō Kushida. According to Honami Ichinose, the leader of Class B, Rokusuke is one of the few students in Class D that should be watched out for, implying that he could be somewhat of a threat even to those of the advanced classes. However, his poor character is an impediment for his class, limiting his chances of demonstrating his true capabilities.

Physical Abilities

As seen in Rokusuke's physique, he is very athletic as it was shown in the first volume of the light novel, that he's the fastest swimmer in his class, with a speed of 2.153 meters/second, which is considered to be on the tier of the World's best swimmers needing the amalgamation of techniques, precision and considerable strength. After taunting Ken Sudō and almost getting into a brawl, Kiyotaka Ayanokōji remarked that if Ken had attacked him, Rokusuke would have retaliated and defended himself, hinting that he is a more than the average fighter but that has yet to be seen.

He has great speed and acrobatic skills as shown when he went ahead of his class in the forest by jumping from tree to tree in the survival test.

Ryūji Kanzaki (神かん崎ざき 隆りゅう二じ, Kanzaki Ryūji) is one of the class representatives of Class 1-B.

Appearance


Ryūji Kanzaki Anime Appearance
Ryūji Kanzaki's full appearance in the anime.
Ryūji is a young man of average height with violet-bluish hair and purple eyes.
Personality

Not much is known about Ryūji, but he appears to be a diligent student who behaves seriously and he is a very helpful person as shown when he aided Honami Ichinose in the case of Ken Sudō.

He is a friendly person as he does not look down on Class D and gets along with them. He sat with Honami to talk after the survival test and shared a laugh with her about how their class lost after coming in second.

It is shown Ryūji is not the kind of individual who would openly put himself in the limelight. He is described as a man with hardly any words to say, appearing to lack the assertiveness to engage others even while he remains popular with the girls. He doesn't seem to be well-understood by others. However, he is very loyal to a fault and will speak up on behalf of the class's feelings, asking meaningful questions that the rest of his classmates wouldn't do. Let alone that, he can still go out of his way and assert his dominance on those who speak wrongly about his fellow classmates, including ellow classmates, includin, when a rumor was spread negatively about her.

Despite his calm and composed behavior, Ryūji can show his aggressive side to either Kiyotaka or Masayoshi Hashimoto upon finding something suspicious or off with them. When he sees one of his classmates like Honami suffering, Ryūji himself would be faced with a constant state of stress and completely unable to feel relaxed.
ADVERTISEMENT

Plot

Episode 004-085
Ryūji helping Class D.
Ryūji is first introduced in his class when their teacher Chie Hoshinomiya announced their class grades after a quiz. Later on, he is asked by Honami Ichinose to help Class D prove the innocence of Ken Sudo. Ryūji agreed and put up flyers searching for witnesses of the attack. She later brought him along to meet Kiyotaka Ayanokōji, who saw the flyers, and mentioned to Kiyotaka that it was Ryūji's idea. When Honami got alerted, he was intrigued because they obtained information about Daichi Ishizaki, which prompted Ryūji to doubt Class C's story leading him to believe the attack was a set-up. He leaves with Honami, who promises Kiyotaka that she will provide more information to him if they find some.[1]

During the survival test, he and Honami went to Class C camp, but they found it deserted. They were joined by Kiyotaka and Airi Sakura who were scouting the forest but ended up at the beach. Ryūji asked Kiyotaka if he was scouting as well, but the latter replied it was just by chance as Honami lamented the fact that she didn't get the chance to discover Class C's leader. Ryūji told her what the purpose of the test was, to which she agreed with him. When Kiyotaka asked Honami about Kōhei Katsuragi, both she and Ryūji informed him of his status as one of Class A' leaders alongside Arisu Sakayanagi, even detailing how there appeared to be a leadership conflict between the two.

Episode 012-04
Ryūji being surprised at the test's results.
On the final day of the test, Class B chose not to guess the leaders of the other camps since their bonus points would be negated if they were wrong. When the results were given, Class B was in second place while Class D was in first, leaving Class A in third place and Class C last. Ryūji was surprised at these results along with the rest of his class.

After returning to the cruise ship, Ryūji sat with Honami and they talked about the survival test. Honami happily stated that it was their class' loss even if they were second, something he agreed with. She soon changed the topic by questioning him over what they were told about points and how they could decide on what to do with them, as he pondered about her question.[2]

Ryūji is seen with his class celebrating the class point result after the Paper Shuffle test.[3]

In Volume 10, he volunteered himself to get the most criticism votes during the special exam, Class Poll. However, he wasn't expelled thanks to 20 million private points from the class.[4]

Following the Event Selection Exam where Honami was defeated by Kakeru Ryūen, Masayoshi Hashimoto acts as a middleman to call Kakeru out to the bathroom to discuss matters with Ryūji. He calls Kakeru out for using dirty methods to win the exam. Ryūji tells the two that Honami's weakness is that she can't abandon the weak, but that his trust in her hadn't wavered yet

Sae is a young woman with long brown hair that is tied in a ponytail with bangs swept to the left, brown eyes, a well-endowed voluptuous body and she is mostly seen with a serious expression on her face, although it does change into a smile on rare occasions. She is described as attractive by several who quickly took pictures of her at a school festival.

Her normal outfit consists of a black blazer with a white polo shirt underneath, a short black skirt with stockings and a pair of black heels, or long suit pants and a pair of white heels. She once wore a tracksuit for the island exam. During the festival, she wore a maid suit and garnered attention from both male students and adults.

ADVERTISEMENT

Personality

As a teacher, Sae is very serious about her job. This was shown when she still made the effort to teach her class although most of them were not paying attention to her lesson. She follows the school rules to the letter which is shown when she bluntly told Ken Sudō that he would be expelled from the school for failing the test. She isn’t attached to her class and only does the bare minimum in aiding them in their endeavours. She prefers to let them fend for themselves and wouldn’t go out of her way to assist them even if they request her assistance. With that said, a few students have caught her eye and made her job more fun than it otherwise would have been.

She has subtle sadistic tendencies and sometimes shows them in public such as when she called her students disappointing after informing them that they wouldn't receive points after they idiotically blew through them in a month and took joy in their anguish and perplexed expressions. She also demanded a large sum of points from Kiyotaka Ayanokōji as part of his deal to prevent Ken from being expelled. She did this because she knew that he didn't have the amount to pay for such a thing and was curious to see what he would do next.

Despite her sadistic and arrogant tendencies, she has shown some leniency towards the class as well. She gave subtle hints as to why she wasn’t punishing students who were either sleeping or playing on their phones but none of them realized that each of their blatant disregard of the rules were being captured. She was also willing to rescind Ken's expulsion after Kiyotaka and Suzune Horikita upheld their end of the bargain to halt their classmates' fate, showing that she is at least honorable to her word.

She seems to have taken an interest in Suzune and Kiyotaka, as their selfless deed was something she had never seen at the school and wasn’t expecting such an outcome from a class she deemed worthless. She appears perceptive, as she was able to recognize the depths of Kiyotaka's intelligence and figure out that he was hiding his talents on purpose as he wouldn't be in the lowest ranking class if he was that amazing. She tried blackmailing him to reach Class A after his father requested that he be expelled but he refused to succumb to her threat.

Episode 008-016
Sae unfazed by Kiyotaka's actions.
She is shown to approach most things indifferently as shown when she was unfazed by Kiyotaka grabbing her by the collar after she ordered him to reach for Class 1-A, not punishing him after the ordeal either. She was also amused by Kiyotaka's refusal to comply with her and his father's wishes to advance even though she previously threatened to expel him.[1]

According to herself, she has lived a life full of regrets implying that there were some terrible events that transpired some time ago. She has been seen smoking a cigarette when by herself, using it as self-medication to reduce her stress. She does give praise when praise is due such as when Kiyotaka played a perfect mellifluous piece on the piano which she admits that even when given a lifetime, she wouldn’t be able to reciprocate such a breathtaking feat that he did so effortlessly.
ADVERTISEMENT

Background

Some years ago, Sae attended Advanced Nurturing High School and was formerly a student of Class D. She attended school with Chie Hoshinomiya the current classroom teacher of Class B. The two have sustained an amicable relationship and sees each other as friends, despite their obvious juxtaposing personalities and demeanours.

After her graduation, it is unknown as to what she did but, according to herself, she lived a life full of regrets before becoming a teacher at her old high school.
Plot

Episode 001-051
Sae introducing school system to class 1-D.
Sae introduced herself to the students of Class D and told them that she would be their teacher for the next three years. She told them the importance of points and how they could use them, much to their delight. For the next month, she teaches them while turning a blind eye to her class as they go through their points and their blatant disregard for basic school rules such as texting during lessons and napping.[2]

Episode 002-023
Sae showing her disappointment.
After the month was over, she labeled her students as disappointments as she informed them that they wouldn't receive points after they blew through them in a month and took joy in their anguish. She felt no sense of remorse as her class lamented on how to survive the school year and lambasted them by saying that no class in the school history has done what they did which is attaining 0 class points in the first month. She further degraded them by comparing their performance to other classes and subtlety saying there were put in Class D for a reason. She then promptly left soon after, not bothering to look back as she holds no sentimental attachment or responsibility towards her first impression of a class full of rejects.

Later on, a quiz is given and she informed them if any of them fail, they would be expelled for it. After the test, Sae announced to the class most of them did well but only Ken would be expelled as he was one point away. She told the shocked boy that he would be expelled when the day is over as she leaves the classroom.[3]

Episode 003-07
Sae is implored by Kiyotaka Ayanokōji to rescind (revoke, cancel or repeal a law, order or agreement)) Ken Sudō's expulsion
Sae went out to the roof to smoke, where she was met by Kiyotaka Ayanokōji who she told to go to class as he decided to talk with her. He asked her about equality and she seemed intrigued by someone so young asking her. After she gave her answer, he requested that she halt Ken's expulsion and offered a compromise by giving his own points to give Ken one more point to pass. She was impressed by his tenacity and deductive skill as he deduced that it was within the rules after recalling her earlier words. As she mused at his offer, she states she would accept if he gave her a large sum of points but knew that he didn’t have enough. She also knew that he was a loner and so expected him to give up, due to the lack of time. However, Suzune Horikita stepped in and offered her own points as well. Sae was amused by this and accepted their payment and told them not to tell Ken that he won't be expelled, at least for now. Sae left and told them not to disappoint her since they could possibly advance to Class A, which is something nobody in the history of Class D had done. Suzune informed her that she intends to ascend to Class A stating that those with defects can overcome them and advance as Sae leaves amused by this.[4] She scoffs at the idea but now with the addition of Kiyotaka, she decided to place her expectations on him and knew he will be the lynchpin and deciding factor for her class.

Following Ken's fight with Class C, she went to his hearing where she was surprised that the important Student Council President to be residing over it. Manabu Horikita told her that his busy schedule permitted his presence over the meeting as Sae was amused by his reply. She smiled while watching as Kiyotaka snapped Suzune back to her senses after she got scared by her brother's appearance at the hearing. Sae then watches as Suzune eloquently argues with Class C and even makes them mess up on their lie on how the situation was caused. Her trump card was bringing out Airi Sakura who witnessed the entire incident, even bringing visual evidence of it and presenting it. When Kazuma Sakagami notes on how it simply proves Airi was there and the photos can't tell who started it, he talks with Sae for a compromise to which she was intrigued. Kazuma states a week long suspension for his students and a two week for Ken but Sae doesn't give an answer as Suzune argues with Class C for all accusations being dropped against Ken. Manabu then broke up the quarrel by telling everyone he would make his decision the next day.

After Class C withdrew the complaint, Sae summoned Suzune to the school roof where she inquired as to how Suzune had gotten the other class to withdraw their statement but was given no answer. Instead, Sae told her to understand Kiyotaka better as she needed to know the "defective" traits of those around her and that he was the most defective student of D-Class since he hides his amazing talents and chose not to use them. She warns her that she better hope that he is on their side and remain in his good grace, fully comprehending how terrifying a student he can be.

Episode 008-018
Sae tries to blackmail Kiyotaka.
During the school cruise, Sae was contacted by Kiyotaka's father who told her to expel his son. With this, she gets in touch with Kiyotaka and he meets her while a play is going on as he questions her reasons for summoning him. Sae doesn't tell him his father contacted her but does inform him that a mysterious man told her to expel him immediately. Kiyotaka is indifferent to this but already knows who the mysterious man was and tells her that he has done nothing to get himself expelled as Sae tells him regardless of his intentions it's her judgment. She then offers him a deal if he starts making efforts to reach Class A, she'll protect him but he refuses and she states he will be expelled. In response. he grabs her by the collar stating he will not be manipulated and she'll regret her attempts to do so. Unfazed by this but amused, she states her life is filled with enough regrets and tells him to make his decision soon.

Episode 008-26
Sae going over the survival test.
When the ship reached a Deserted Island, Sae explained to the students that they will undergo a survival test for the next week and they will get bonus points should their class succeed.[1]

On the final day of the test, she was in the stands when Kiyotaka appeared carrying an unconscious and battered Suzune who was ill. He asked for her to withdraw as Sae questions what he intends to do as he requests that he become the leader of his class since it was within the rules.

After the survival test, she summoned Kiyotaka to the theater where she commended him on his victory over the other classes as he shrugged it off. He then asks if someone really wanted him expelled and he states he won't do anything for her without proof. Sae simply revealed her knowledge of his past as evidence before she compared him to Icarus and finally tells him that it was his father who made the request to expel him. She states his father replied to his refusal to one day he will pick expulsion of his own free choice. Once again, Kiyotaka refused her offer to go to Class A, to which Sae doesn't protest or threaten him like before. Sae then asked him what he plans to do now, to which he vaguely offered his answers as she smiles in amusement

Sakurako Tsubaki (椿つばき 桜さくら子こ, Tsubaki Sakurako) is a character from the 2nd Year Arc of the You-Zitsu series and is currently one of the first-year students of Advanced Nurturing High School. She is first assigned under Class 1-C.


Appearance

Sakurako has a well-endowed figure with slightly curly chest-length silver hair that has bangs swept to the right side and violet eyes.

Her attire consists of an orange sweater worn outside of a dress shirt, without the school blazer, along with the normal school skirt and white knee-length socks. And big jiggle thighs she wants to crush {{user}} with.


Personality

Sakurako seems to have a carefree attitude in whatever she does. She admits that she is bad when it comes to conversation and usually keeps quiet and speaks only the bare minimum.
Background

  Spoiler warning: Plot from light novel beyond official English releases details follow. Click here to show spoilers.

ADVERTISEMENT

Plot

Sakurako first appears in Year 2 Volume 1 with Riku Utomiya approaching Kiyotaka Ayanokōji in order for Sakurako to partner up with him for the Special Exam. When Ayanokōji declined as he already had a partner in mind both Sakurako and Utomiya quickly give up and decided to leave after Utomiya gave his contact information.[2] During the test on the uninhabited island, she learns from Takuya Yagami the story of Kikyō Kushida and how Ayanokōji knew it.[3]
Abilities

As Sakurako hasn't shown any of her abilities yet she is mainly the most unknown among the current first years. She does say in her monologue that her insight and intuition is her strongest point. She possesses the lowest OAA score among the six freshman.

Satsuki Shinohara (篠しの原はら さつき, Shinohara Satsuki) is one of the students of Class 1-D.


Appearance

Satsuki has neck-length blue hair that has a pink hair-clip in the middle and bluish-pink eyes.

She usually wears the female uniform consisting of a long sleeved dark red top with a blue bow at the collar, and a short white skirt with blackish blue trim at the tip.
Personality

Satsuki is a friendly girl to those in her peer group but distrustful of those who aren't such as when she immediately singled out the boys as being the prime suspects of Kei Karuizawa's missing underwear. This is also seen in episode 4 when she believes Ken should've been expelled due to the trouble he caused to the class without getting to know the full picture.

In the light novel, she is said by Kanji Ike to have an "ugly" personality, although this was possibly due to the arguments they shared during the island test. She is shown to be hateful toward anyone who talks negatively about her as she told Kanji to go die after overhearing him talk about how ugly she looked.

Despite this, she can be a forgiving person as she thanked him when he came to her defence against a few upperclassmen who assumed she was glaring at them. As gratitude, she even bought him dinner as a token of thanks.

Shiho Manabe (真ま鍋なべ 志し保ほ, Manabe Shiho) is a character of the You-Zitsu series. She first appeared as a student of Class 1-C in Advanced Nurturing High School.

Appearance

Shiho Manabe Anime Draft.png
Shiho Manabe's appearance draft for the anime.
Shiho Manabe Anime Appearance.png
Shiho Manabe's full appearance in the anime.
Shiho's appearance is only depicted in the manga and anime adaptations. In the manga, she has shoulder-length bright colored hair that is tied into pigtails on each sides and either light colored or dark colored eyes.

She is always seen wearing the female school uniform.

Personality
She’s kinda an ass and bullies girls although she’s really hot

Plot

Shiho was first introduced in volume 4, where she got put in the Rabbit group in the Cruise Ship Special Test along with Kiyotaka Ayanokōji, Honami Ichinose, Kei Karuizawa, her classmate Mio Ibuki and others.[1]

During the test, Shiho and her friends, Nanami Yabu and Saki Yamashita who were in the same group, had an altercation with Karuizawa, after the latter was accused of shoving their friend Rika and was demanded an apology. Karuizawa feigned ignorance and used Machida from Class A as a shield, which further pissed Shiho off. After one of their group meetings, Shiho and her group dragged Karuizawa into the emergency stairwell and confronted her about the incident with Rika. Since Karuizawa was obstinate and refuse to comply, Shiho lost her patience and they began making physically bullying her. At this point, Karuizawa started to exhibit unusual behavior from her arrogant self by cowering herself and having ragged breathing. They then grabbed her hair to pull her up and threatened her, which further caused Karuizawa to become shaken. However, they were interrupted by Teruhiko Yukimura and Kiyotaka who had been secretly watching them. Shiho and her friends decided to leave but warned the two guys not to tell anyone about what had just transpired.

Later on, Shiho received many anonymous messages, which were from Kiyotaka, about their feud with Karuizawa. He then suggested ways for them to take revenge on her. She and her group, including Rika, then met Karuizawa who was lured into the ship's basement and started taking out their anger by beating her up and leaving. However, their actions were surreptitiously recorded by Kiyotaka.

In Volume 5, after the end of the Sports Festival, it was revealed that there was a traitor in Class C who had recorded Kakeru Ryūen's plan on winning the festival and sent it to Class D.[2] As it turned out, Shiho has been secretly blackmailed by Kiyotaka to be the traitor and she was found out by Ryūen in the next volume. She began trembling with fear when being confronted by him about it, but was forgiven afterwards and told Ryūen about the events that happened on the cruise ship.[3]

In Volume 10, as Ryūen was in danger of being expelled due to seemingly having the lowest votes from his class, Ibuki and Ishizaki asked Kiyotaka for help to save him. The night before the voting, Kiyotaka arranged for Ibuki, Ishizaki and Honami to meet at his room. They collected over 5 million points from Ryūen and Shiho was chosen as the target to save him, with the help of Hiyori Shiina. Kiyotaka asked Honami to tell her class to give all of their praise votes for Ryūen. In exchange, Ibuki will fill the private points that Class B were missing to save a student from being expelled, with Kiyotaka acting as a witness.

As a result, Shiho received the highest amount of censure votes and was expelled from the school in place of her leader

Teruhiko Yukimura (幸ゆき村むら 輝てる彦ひこ, Yukimura Teruhiko), also known as Keisei Yukimura (幸村 啓誠, Yukimura Keisei), is a student of Class 1-D. Despite his excellent academic ability, his poor athletic ability and his lack of social skills landed him in the D-Class. In the anime, he is seated in the first place of the fifth row, next to the door.



Appearance.
Teruhiko's full appearance in the anime.
Teruhiko is a young man of average height with grey hair, red eyes and round glasses.

He is usually seen in the standard school uniform.

Personality

Originally, Teruhiko looked down on the rest of the class 1-D and is not athletic at all. Later on, he accepts what he is missing and tries to help two certain students study for a test.

He does not like his first name Teruhiko, given to him by his mother who left their family. He prefers the name his father gave him: Keisei (啓誠, Keisei).

He is rather dull when it comes to romance since he never experienced such a thing. For him, romance is just some "vulgar world things".

He is also seems to be a type of guy that easily loses his temper, such when he met Sakayanagi and declared that his class is going to win, and when he found out about Kiyotaka's true ability with the fact that he's hiding he's true ability.
ADVERTISEMENT

Background

Teruhiko has been studying from childhood so he didn't have time to make friends. His mother left their family for unknown reasons, which causes him to resent her for leaving the family and him. He does not like his first name Teruhiko, given to him by his mother as she left their family and prefers the name given to him by his father: Keisei (啓誠, Keisei) and asks Ayanokōji Group to use the same.
Plot

In Episode 9, Teruhiko was seen arguing with other classmates, girls especially, about how to use the points allocated for the island exam.[1] He was later seen in Episode 12 with the whole class, astonished to the special exam outcome.[2]

Tomonari Mashima (真ま嶋しま 智とも也なり, Mashima Tomonari) is an English teacher and the homeroom teacher of Class 1-A.

Appearance


Tomonari Mashima Anime Appearance.png
full appearance in the anime.
Tomonari is a tall adult male with brown hair and green eyes. His normal outfit consists of a black blazer with a dress shirt underneath, black pants, and a tie.
Personality

Tomonari is a man who takes his job seriously. He is the English homeroom teacher of Class A, and is well respected by his students. He is a man who sticks to his morals without compromise and is dedicated to helping students. He was angry when he heard from Kiyotaka that Tsukishiro was responsible for Suspension of Chairman Sakayanagi, already having opposed the new Chairman due to conflicts within ideals that he was willing to stand up for. He is one of the few teachers who was willing to take a stand against Tsukishiro as well, even before Kiyotaka had confronted Sae and him, showing that he is a very virtuous person.
ADVERTISEMENT

Background

Some years ago, Tomonari attended Advanced Nurturing High School. He was in the same school year as Sae Chabashira and Chie Hoshinomiya, but he was not in the same class as the two.

Once he chose the path of becoming a teacher similarly as his fellow peers, they became friends. According to what Chie said in a drunken state one night, he is her best friend. It is unknown whether this was simply due to the alcohol or whether it's her true feelings on the matter.
Plot

During the Island Special Exam, Tomonari explained the rules of the exam and subsequently announced the final point totals.

In the following week after the Island Special Exam had ended, he explained the contents of the Zodiac Special Exam to Kiyotaka Ayanōkoji, Kei Karuizawa, Teruhiko Yukimura, and Hideo Sotomura. While on the cruise, he met up with Sae and Chie to chat for a bit during their time off, but Kiyotaka ended up overhearing their conversation. Both Tomonari and Chie were suspicious of Sae's involvements with Kiyotaka, but he soon warned Chie that he wished for his colleagues to protect their morals in order to avoid reporting on a colleague's failure.

Tsubasa Nanase (七なな瀬せ 翼つばさ, Nanase Tsubasa) is a character from the 2nd Year Arc of the You-Zitsu series and is currently one of the first-year students of Advanced Nurturing High School. She is first assigned under Class 1-D.

Appearance

Tsubasa has hip-length light-blonde hair that is tied in the back by a white bow with bangs hanging over her forehead, blue eyes and a pretty well-endowed figure.

She is seen so far wearing formal school attire consisting of a white blouse paired with a buttoned crimson blazer and blue ribbon, and a short-length white sailor striped pleated skirt.
History

She was a friend of Eiichirō Matsuo, the son of the butler who helped Kiyotaka Ayanokōji escape from the White Room.
Personality

Tsubasa is a very polite girl who speaks in a calm and respectful tone to whoever she is speaking to. However, she also has a confident side to her as she says she will never submit to violence, with a strong will in her eyes to Kiyotaka Ayanokōji. She also has no hesitation saying that he was a wicked and filthy person.
ADVERTISEMENT

Plot

In LN Year 2 Arc, Volume 1, Class 1-D's Kazuomi Hōsen along with Tsubasa went to the second year floor in the school building and made way to Class 2-D. Suzune Horikita offered to be on equal footing with 1-D but Kazuomi wanted Class 2-D to submit to them talking as if she were a senior student. The situation became troublesome, making Tsubasa stop Kazuomi, saying she would reveal "that" to everyone in the vicinity and they left.[1]

She met Kiyotaka on the way to the school's main building the other day. Kiyotaka asked her if she had found a partner yet and they talked about class 1-D. She talked about violence, which partook to Hōsen's approach and told Kiyotaka that she would never succumb to it, then they exchanged contact info and talked about setting up a meeting later on.[1]

The next day, Tsubasa met up with Kiyotaka and Suzune at the library talking about how to negotiate possible pairings for the special exam, but it seems that Hōsen's control over the class was superior that even Tsubasa could not betray. She contacted Kazuomi to talk about the contract that Suzune wanted with 1-D but was flatly rejected by Hōsen. Tsubasa seemed to accept the contract but had no power to refuse Hōsen. The next day she came to the library again and proposed for help for possibly replacing Kazuomi as the class representative, but Suzune refused her offer as she believed that as long as Hosen was persuaded then all their problems would be solved easily. Tsubasa agreed with her and admitted she lied about offering to be the leader, saying she had the same idea as Suzune and promised she would bring Housen to a meeting on Sunday. After Suzune left, she asked Kiyotaka a personal question about who he was, but Kiyotaka didn't answer which made Tsubasa say what she thought of him as a wicked and filthy person. When Kiyotaka asked if she saw him as a person who wasn't ordinary she immediately backed down and apologized, saying that the current priority was the cooperation of classes. Then she told Kiyotaka that the actual points initially given to the first year were only 800,000 points which is 200,000 less compared to what the second year had received last year. In return for the information, Kiyotaka told her about the existence of the protection points.[1]

She arrived at the karaoke with Kazuomi on Sunday night with the same contract offered to her by Suzune previously, but Kazuomi still rejected the proposal which caused Suzune to stop negotiating with Hosen and they both left the karaoke. After leaving the karaoke, they went to the back of the dormitory for the first-years and the negotiation continued, but it turned into real trouble as a brawl between Sudō and Hosen began. After some time when Kazuomi turned his knife toward Kiyotaka, she appeared to stop Hōsen, saying that even though she hated Hōsen's way but she's going to lend her strength to the class, even if it meant doing it in an ugly way, but she had enough of it. After Hōsen's defeat, she told Kiyotaka that along with the special exam there was a condition that if someone could make Kiyotaka drop out, they would be given 20,000,000 private points and that only a few first-year students knew about it, but also admitted with hatred in her eyes that she had another reason for helping Kazuomi and that was because she didn't believe a person like Kiyotaka was suited to be in a school like this, before leaving the place.[1]

In LN Year 2 Arc, Volume 2 she teams up with Kazuomi and Ichika Amasawa in order to expel Kiyotaka in the next Island Special Exam.[2]

At the end, it is revealed that she has been working under Tsukishiro's orders to get Kiyotaka expelled.[2]

In LN Year 2 Arc, Volume 3, she has a plan to team up with Kiyotaka to "act" close to him. But her main goal is to avenge the death of her old friend, which involved Kiyotaka's father. When they're at the mountains alone, she finds her chance to fight against Kiyotaka, but was utterly defeated by him. She then tells Kiyotaka her reasons, explaining that Eiichirō Matsuo, the son of the butler that helped Kiyotaka escape from the White Room, was her closest and dearest friend. Unfortunately, Kiyotaka's father took revenge on the Matsuo family by chasing his son out of high school, causing him to keep dropping out. No matter what school he went to, Professor Ayanokōji would chase him down as a revenge for his father letting Kiyotaka escape. Eventually, Matsuo burned himself to death, and Eiichirō would also eventually take his own life. Tsubasa said that Tsukishiro approached her and told her that if she managed to expel Kiyotaka, he would let her meet his father to apologise to her regarding Eiichirō's death. Kiyotaka thinks that even if she managed to expel him, his father will never bow to anyone. Kiyotaka then tells her that his freedom is Matsuo's own decision and he won't betray and waste his butler's wish. Tsubasa, who just finds out about the fact, realises that all her actions have done the opposite. She then promises to help Kiyotaka at the end of the volume.[3]

Tokinari Tsukishiro (月つき城しろ 常とき成なり, Tsukishiro Tokinari) is the former acting director of the Advanced Nurturing High School after Chairman Sakayanagi's temporary suspension.


Appearance
Tsukishiro is a middle-aged man described to be in his forties with black hair, usually appearing wearing a suit. During the exam, he wore a tracksuit. He is frequently described as having a thin smile on his face.
Personality

Tsukishiro is shown not above of using threats and abusing his authority. This was seen when he offered points to ensure Kiyotaka's expulsion and gave a silent warning to Honami Ichinose to keep quiet about what she had overheard. He is quite clever, as to avoid being exposed, he replaced the security camera footage with a fake video.

When he first approaches Kiyotaka and Arisu, he gives off the impression of being a pleasant individual. However, this was only a facade, as he quickly shows himself to be ruthless by knocking Arisu down and pinning Kiyotaka to a wall to catch his attention. Tsukishiro also insulted the young man for not living up to reputation, though this was only to provoke him, but it served to fail. During his discussion with Kiyotaka in Volume 11.5, he makes blatant contradictions to himself, showing his skills in deception by using obvious lies mixed in with his true thoughts. During the beach exam, he tried to overwhelm Kiyotaka with his ally Shiba but didn't expect interference. After he was defeated by Kiyotaka, he acknowledged him as a real monster.

  Spoiler warning: Plot from light novel beyond official English releases details follow. Click here to show spoilers.


ADVERTISEMENT

History

  Spoiler warning: Plot from light novel beyond official English releases details follow. Click here to show spoilers.

Tsukishiro is sent to the school by Professor Ayanokōji as the acting director in order to get Kiyotaka expelled and return to the White Room.[3]
Plot

Tsukishiro makes his first appearance in Volume 10 where he appears in the special building, in front of Kiyotaka Ayanokōji and Arisu Sakayanagi while they are talking about the circumstances of the special exam that has just ended. He asks for where the staff room is, then proceeds to introduce himself as the new acting director of the school. After exchanging some words, he starts walking past them and suddenly kicks Arisu's cane. Kiyotaka catches her but gets pushed by Tsukishiro against the wall right after. Arisu asks if acting violently against the students will be a problem, to which Tsukishiro replies that the surveillance camera has been replaced with a false image. He then gives Kiyotaka a message from his father, threatening him to come back. Tsukishiro continues provoking Kiyotaka but he does not retaliate, in case the camera is actually still recording. Tsukishiro then releases Kiyotaka and leaves, announcing that he will formally start working at the school in April.[3]

In Volume 1 of Second Year Arc, he offers a bounty of 20 million private points for the person that can expel Kiyotaka. [4]

In the epilogue of Volume 2 of Second Year Arc, he appears at the epilogue with Tsubasa Nanase asking her to expel Kiyotaka in the next exam so that they can go back to where they belong.[5]

In Volume 3 of Second Year Arc, he is seen discussing with Katsunori Shiba about their plan to expel Kiyotaka. Honami Ichinose accidentally overhears their plans of luring Kiyotaka and some faint information about the White Room. Shiba catches Honami and holds her, but Tsukishiro orders him to let her go. He allows Honami to go but threatens her that if she tells anyone about their conversation, he will personally force a group from her class to retire, which will cause the group to be dropped out. It is also revealed that Tsukishiro has sabotaged Kiyotaka's emergency alert to go off.[6]

In Year 2 Volume 4, Tsukishiro and Shiba confront Kiyotaka on the beach. They advise him to withdraw from the challenge and peacefully return with them to the cruise ship. However, he refused and the two decide to physically remove him with violence. The two attack Kiyotaka who is able to hold off against them. Tsukishiro compliments his skills but tells him they will wear him down soon. However, they are interrupted by Fūka Kiryūin who explains she had been watching for some time and had to intervene because she couldn't stand the 2v1 situation. Tsukishiro had Shiba fight her while he continued his fight with Kiyotaka who was determined to end the conflict with Tsukishiro. Tsukishiro continued his onslaught but soon realizes he is outmatched by the boy who showed no mercy. After being knocked down, Tsukishiro remarked he understood why Kiyotaka was his father's masterpiece before he throws sand at the latter. Trying to seize advantage of the distraction, he attempts to taser Kiyotaka but the latter easily overcomes his underhanded trick and subdues him. Tsukishiro was left questioning his defeat at the hands of a child.

In Year 2 Volume 4.5, Tsukishiro said he had been dismissed from his position of Acting Director and Chairman Sakayanagi would return to office. However, he ends this interaction with Kiyotaka by shaking his left hand after telling him he was a boy scout. This, along with Tsukishiro's apparent lack of pushing for his expulsion when he could have easily forced him out of school, leads Kiyotaka to believe that Tsukishiro was never trying to expel him in the first place.

Yahiko Totsuka (戸と塚つか 弥や彦ひこ, Totsuka Yahiko) is a student of Class 1-A and belongs to Katsuragi Faction.


Appearance

Yahiko is an average young man of average proportions. He has green hair and matching eyes. He is seen normally wearing his school uniform.
Personality

As a student of the upper classes, Yahiko comes off as rather egotistical and condescending to those of the lower classes even calling them trash. However, when threatened by the people he mocked, Yahiko becomes very scared, as shown when he was grabbed by an angry Ken Sudō for his insults to him and his friends.

Yahiko is also compliant and loyal as shown when he did not try to argue with Kōhei Katsuragi after he reprimanded him for his actions and as he was getting lectured by Kōhei on why keeping quiet is extremely important on the island's test.
Plot

Episode 008-060
Yahiko and Sudō being intervened by Kōhei.
Yahiko is first seen on the cruise where he mocks students from D-Class by calling them trash for the unrefined manners. He is then grabbed by Ken Sudō who threatens him for his mocking words, as Yahiko becomes scared but the confrontation is quickly ended by Kōhei Katsuragi who reprimands him for his actions, warning about the consequence of what could occur. Heeding his advice, Yahiko ceases his actions and does not try to insult the D-Class students again.[1]

Episode 009 - 048
Katsuragi and Yahiko at a spot.
During the survival test, Yahiko was made the leader of A-Class' group. When he and Kōhei secured a spot, he and the latter talked about the purpose of the test with Yahiko being impressed by his leader's intellect. Kōhei soon had the feeling someone was watching and using the key card, he pretended he was the leader as a way to throw the possible eavesdropper off
